title: The Cipher of Tashkent Revisited
author: Rosalind Okonkwo
blurb: Marguerite Pemberton, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
